The Presque Isle River emptying into Lake Superior in the Porcupine Mountains State Park in the remote Western part of Michigan's Upper Peninsula. Rugged reddish brown rocky shorelines made of ancient lava and littered with colored stones tumbled by the lake, boreal forests, and waterfalls.

The Presque Isle River in Michigan's Porcupine Mountains is nothing short of incredible. It is beautiful year round, but in the spring it truly comes to life. Water rushes over the falls along its route out to Lake Superior, casting mist up into the air creating an almost dreamlike scene.

May 2023

Last Tuesday I spent the day at the Porcupine Mountains in the UP of Michigan. Within hours I saw a lighthouse, stepped my toes in Lake Superior, hiked to a 2,000' summit and viewed some spectacular waterfalls on the Presque Isle River. What a magical place

I also had a chance to look through the baptismal registers, where I found what I camd for: records of baptisms done by Fr. Jean-Baptiste Proulx, back in 1836. He was pastor in Penetanguishene at the time, but used to travel all along the north shore of Lake Huron for ministry.
